description.narrative: (Ethiopia): The Digital Health Activity (DHA) is strengthening the capacity of the Ministry of Health's (MOH) Health Information System (HIS) to improve data quality, collection, management, analysis, and utilization of health data to improve healthcare quality and delivery..The activity strengthens the capacity of the MOH and Regional Health Bureaus to use data and evidence to inform health standards, protocols, and standard operating procedures. ..DHA also works with health science colleges to improve delivery of quality pre-service and in-service training programs, develop standard electronic training contents on multiple HIS competencies, and strengthen local universities to serve as Centers of Excellence on digital health systems........ .
